oily.note: Oily skin — avoid heavy oils, use aloe vera and rose water

dry.note: Dry skin — avoid harsh acids and clay, use oils and honey

sensitive.note: Sensitive skin — avoid all acids, use only gentle ingredients

combination.note: Combination skin — use aloe vera all over, oils on dry areas only

normal.note: Normal skin — follow plan as-is, no swaps needed

10-20.note: Teen skin — focus on prevention. Do NOT use anti-aging products like castor oil or kumkumadi. Sunscreen is your most important habit.

21-30.note: Start rosehip oil at night and sunscreen daily — best age to build these habits.

31-40.note: Double your oil massage time to 10 min. Add shatavari or ashwagandha in warm milk nightly.

40+.note: 15 min oil massage every morning is non-negotiable. Add chyawanprash daily. Maximum nourishment is your priority.

summer.tip: Refrigerate rose water and aloe vera — cold application gives extra cooling. Apply sunscreen every 3 hours outdoors.

winter.tip: Apply sesame oil 15 min before bath daily. Use warm water only for face wash. Never cold water in winter.

monsoon.tip: Dry your face thoroughly after every wash. Neem is your most important ingredient this season — prevents fungal growth.

autumn.tip: Begin oil massage routine now. Transition from cold to warm water for face wash. Skin entering winter needs oil.

lifestyle.high_stress: High stress tip: Brahmi + ashwagandha in warm milk every night reduces cortisol — directly improves your skin.
lifestyle.poor_sleep: Sleep tip: Your skin repairs 10 PM to 2 AM. Sleep before 10:30 PM — this is treatment, not luxury.
lifestyle.low_water: Water tip: Drink 2 glasses warm water immediately on waking. Skin is 64% water — hydration shows on your face tomorrow.
lifestyle.vegan: Vegan tip: Replace all milk in this plan with almond milk or oat milk. Replace honey in diet with jaggery.
lifestyle.female: Skin is oiliest and most acne-prone on days 22-28 of your cycle. Reduce dairy and sugar those days.
